ROLLING_MULTINOMIAL_LOG_ODDS.feature_transform: none; raw log-odds are not standardised or otherwise fitted
ROLLING_MULTINOMIAL_LOG_ODDS.fit: per fold, expanding prior years only
ROLLING_MULTINOMIAL_LOG_ODDS.model: three-class softmax with a 3x3 coefficient matrix: intercept, log(p3_raw/p0_raw), log(p1_raw/p0_raw)
ROLLING_MULTINOMIAL_LOG_ODDS.objective: sum_i[-log softmax(X_i B)[y_i]] + ||B||_F^2/(2*C), minimized by deterministic L-BFGS-B from B=0

regularization.selection: fixed before outcome access; no C search

ROLLING_STRATIFIED_SHRINKAGE.estimate: for each stratum s, p_s=(class_count_s + 100*global_observed_class_frequency)/(n_s+100); every test row in s receives p_s
ROLLING_STRATIFIED_SHRINKAGE.fallback: n_s=0 in the same fixed formula, equal to the global prior
ROLLING_STRATIFIED_SHRINKAGE.fit: per fold, expanding prior years only

dispersion_categories.MISSING: one or more 10h relative ranges missing

quality_gate.gate: within each fold, retain the first ceil(coverage*test_n) rows after score DESC, then kickoff_ts ASC, issue ASC, match_idx ASC, match_id ASC; the gate is identical across calibration methods
quality_gate.learning_boundary: all score estimates and score cutoffs use only the fold training years; held-out outcomes never set a gate
quality_gate.prior: prior-fold global raw-devig Top1 hit rate
quality_gate.score: method-independent prior-fold smoothed RAW-devig Top1 correctness estimate; calibration changes the probability vector, while this separately learned match-quality gate uses only pre-outcome market state
quality_gate.selection_boundary: Gate B reports all fixed arms. A later policy nomination is not permitted unless PI accepts a separately explicit chronological selector; this Gate-A card therefore does not select a winner using held-out outcomes
